name: kivun-center
description: Build tooling for Kivun Center plugin assets (minification).

scripts.build:css: cleancss -o assets/css/frontend.min.css assets/css/frontend.css && cleancss -o assets/css/admin.min.css assets/css/admin.css && cleancss -o assets/css/accessibility.min.css assets/css/accessibility.css
scripts.build:js: terser assets/js/frontend.js -c -m -o assets/js/frontend.min.js && terser assets/js/admin-crm.js -c -m -o assets/js/admin-crm.min.js && terser assets/js/accessibility.js -c -m -o assets/js/accessibility.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
